lines.text: God spoke to our fathers through the prophets, but in these last days He has spoken to us by His Son.
After providing purification for sins, the Son sat down at the right hand of the Majesty on high.
God never told any angel "You are My Son," and He says of the angels that He makes them winds and flames of fire.

wrong_details.true: winds, His servants flames of fire

lines.text: God anointed the Son above His companions with the oil of joy because He loved righteousness and hated wickedness.
The Lord first announced this salvation, the prophets of old confirmed it to us, and God affirmed it through signs and wonders.
